name: The Blacksmith's Son
source:
In The Blacksmiths Son, you play the role of (surprise, surprise!) the son of a blacksmith. Ever since you were a young boy, you wanted to learn and become skilled in the art of combat, and see the world for what it is.  Maybe it was watching men march off to battle from the walls of Adenvalle, the village you live in, or maybe it was watching your Uncle train when he came to visit? Hearing stories of how he helped rescue a damsel in distress or took part in reclaiming areas taken by the Ratjai tribe.

In a fictional world loosely based off of real events during a medieval period, take the reigns of a young man growing up in chaotic circumstances, as raiders come to take over the lands you know of and call home, looting and selling your country men and women to slavery. From the Lords scouts, you catch wind that there is raiders marching towards the Adenvalle.

What seems like trouble drawing near and about to begin, Lord Eadwig of Adenvalle has kept his trusted circle members close to give him advice on the situation at hand.

But what if trouble has already begun and the so called "trustworthy" folk are not so trustworthy?...

[From [url=https://romeo3d.itch.io/the-blacksmiths-son]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《The Blacksmith’s Son》中，你将扮演——没错，惊不惊喜——一个铁匠的儿子。从小，你就渴望学习战斗、精通武艺，亲眼看看世界的真貌。也许，这源于你站在家乡阿登维尔村的城墙上，看着男人们奔赴战场；也许，是因为叔叔来访时，你看过他的训练，听他讲述自己如何解救落难女子，或参与夺回被拉特贾伊部族占领的地区。

这个虚构世界松散地取材于中世纪的真实事件。你将引导一名年轻人在动荡中成长：劫掠者入侵了你熟悉的故土，四处洗劫，将你的同胞男女卖为奴隶。从领主的斥候那里，你得知一支劫掠队伍正向阿登维尔进发。

祸事似乎已然迫近，一触即发。阿登维尔的埃德维格领主把信任的亲随召集在身边，商议眼前的局势。

可如果祸事早已开始，而那些所谓“值得信任”的人，其实并不可信呢……？

[摘自[url=https://romeo3d.itch.io/the-blacksmiths-son]Itch.io[/url]]
